newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips ease, while techs, bonds firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips ease, while techs, bonds firm.

text.p: The Dow industrials moved lower on Wednesday, as several of its components weakened despite firm bonds and the growing conviction the Federal Reserve would not raise rates at its meeting today.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average, which closed higher yesterday, lost around 21 points to 7701. Among its components, AT&T Corp was active and down 1-5/16 at 35-1/16, while Disney Corp was down 1-9/16 at 77.
Italy's STET/Telecom Italia said it was entering a strategic global telecoms alliance with AT&T, but AT&T said it was premature to discuss taking an equity stake in STET.

Disney's stock also weakened. Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said it downgraded the stock to hold from accumulate. Analyst Alan Kassan said he was concerned the company's ABC unit would fall deeper into third place in the coming television season.
But technology stocks, weaker yesterday, firmed, with the Nasdaq composite up around seven points to 1445.
The long bond was up 7/32 at a 6.73 percent yield.
The Federal Reserve was expected to announce its verdict on interest rates at around 1415 EDT/1815 GMT.
